# Geopolitical Update: Deep Dive Analysis

Report 079 | Published 2022-03-06 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2022-3-6/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/079.json)

War reframes reserves, commodities and investability.

The clearest successes are trade reorientation, reserve diversification and European defence spending. The report explicitly admits the Russian-equity failure. Several geopolitical paths are scenarios, not forecasts; none are promoted to wins merely because turmoil occurred. Europe's adaptation and sustained positive real rates challenge the most rigid resource and debt constraints.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

## Framework lessons

- Custody and jurisdiction are part of asset quality.

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
